question.en: A network connecting 5 food stalls forms a cycle graph (pentagon). How many vertices (V) and edges (E) does it have?
question.ms: Rangkaian yang menghubungkan 5 gerai makanan membentuk graf kitaran (pentagon). Berapakah bucu (V) dan tepi (E) yang dimilikinya?

feedback.en: Correct! A pentagon cycle has 5 vertices and 5 edges.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Kitaran pentagon mempunyai 5 bucu dan 5 tepi.

feedback.en: 5 vertices with 4 edges is a tree, not a cycle.
feedback.ms: 5 bucu dengan 4 tepi ialah pokok, bukan kitaran.

feedback.en: There are 5 stalls (vertices).
feedback.ms: Terdapat 5 gerai (bucu).

feedback.en: 10 edges would be a complete graph K_5.
feedback.ms: 10 tepi ialah graf lengkap K_5.

en: Count the number of stall locations (vertices) and connecting roads (edges).
ms: Kira bilangan lokasi gerai (bucu) dan jalan penghubung (tepi).

en: 5 stalls = 5 vertices. Pentagon cycle = 5 edges.
ms: 5 gerai = 5 bucu. Kitaran pentagon = 5 tepi.

question.en: In a delivery network, vertex v is connected to 3 distinct edges without loops. What is the degree of vertex v, d(v)?
question.ms: Dalam rangkaian penghantaran, bucu v disambungkan kepada 3 tepi tanpa gelung. Apakah darjah bagi bucu v, d(v)?

feedback.en: Correct! The degree is the number of edges incident to the vertex.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Darjah ialah bilangan tepi yang mengaitkan bucu tersebut.

feedback.en: Each simple edge contributes 1 to the degree of vertex v.
feedback.ms: Setiap tepi mudah menyumbang 1 kepada darjah bucu v.

feedback.en: There are 3 connecting edges.
feedback.ms: Terdapat 3 tepi penghubung.

feedback.en: d(v) is equal to 3.
feedback.ms: d(v) bersamaan 3.

en: The degree of a vertex is the number of edges connected to it.
ms: Darjah sesuatu bucu ialah bilangan tepi yang bersambung dengannya.

question.en: A network graph has 8 edges. What is the sum of degrees of all vertices in this graph?
question.ms: Suatu graf rangkaian mempunyai 8 tepi. Apakah jumlah darjah bagi semua bucu dalam graf ini?

feedback.en: Correct! ∑ d(v) = 2E = 2 × 8 = 16.
Each edge connects two vertices and contributes 2 to the sum.
feedback.ms: Setiap tepi menghubungkan dua bucu dan menyumbang 2 darjah.

feedback.en: Multiply by 2, not 3.
feedback.ms: Darabkan dengan 2, bukan 3.

feedback.en: Formula is 2E, not E².
feedback.ms: Rumus ialah 2E, bukan E².

en: Handshaking Lemma: Sum of degrees = 2 × Number of edges (2E).
ms: Gunakan Teorem Jabat Tangan: Jumlah darjah = 2 × Bilangan tepi (2E).

question.en: Which feature distinguishes a multigraph from a simple graph?
question.ms: Ciri manakah yang membezakan graf berganda daripada graf mudah?

options.text: A multigraph can contain loops or multiple edges between the same vertices.

feedback.en: Correct! Simple graphs have no loops and no multiple edges.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Graf mudah tidak mengandungi gelung atau berbilang tepi.

options.text: A multigraph has only straight lines.

feedback.en: Line curvature does not define a multigraph.
feedback.ms: Kelengkungan garis tidak mentakrifkan graf berganda.

feedback.en: All graphs must have vertices.
feedback.ms: Semua graf mesti mempunyai bucu.

options.text: A multigraph must have directed arrows.

feedback.en: That defines a directed graph (digraph).
feedback.ms: Itu mentakrifkan graf terarah.

en: A simple graph has no loops and no multiple edges.
ms: Graf mudah tidak mempunyai gelung dan tiada berbilang tepi.

en: Multigraphs may contain loops and multiple edges.
ms: Graf berganda boleh mengandungi gelung dan berbilang tepi.

question.en: In a one-way street delivery network, roads have specified travel directions with arrows. What type of graph is this?
question.ms: Dalam rangkaian penghantaran jalan sehala, jalan mempunyai arah perjalanan dengan anak panah. Apakah jenis graf ini?

feedback.en: Correct! Edges with directional arrows are directed graphs.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Tepi yang mempunyai anak panah arah ialah graf terarah.

feedback.en: Undirected graphs have bidirectional edges without arrows.
feedback.ms: Graf tak terarah tidak mempunyai anak panah.

feedback.en: A tree is defined by connectivity and absence of cycles.
feedback.ms: Pokok ditakrifkan oleh keterhubungan dan ketiadaan kitaran.

feedback.en: A complete graph connects every pair of vertices.
feedback.ms: Graf lengkap menghubungkan setiap pasangan bucu.

en: Arrows on edges indicate a directed graph.
ms: Anak panah pada tepi menandakan graf terarah.

en: Edges with directions form a directed graph.
ms: Tepi yang berarah membentuk graf terarah.

question.en: Which of the following degree sequences can form a valid simple graph?
question.ms: Antara jujukan darjah berikut, yang manakah boleh membentuk suatu graf mudah yang sah?

feedback.en: Correct! Sum = 2 + 3 + 3 + 4 = 12 (even number of odd-degree vertices).
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jumlah = 12 (bilangan bucu berdarjah ganjil adalah genap).

feedback.en: Sum = 9 (odd), which violates the Handshaking Lemma!
feedback.ms: Jumlah = 9 (ganjil), melanggar Teorem Jabat Tangan!

feedback.en: Sum = 13 (odd), impossible.
feedback.ms: Jumlah = 13 (ganjil), mustahil.

feedback.en: Sum = 5 (odd), impossible.
feedback.ms: Jumlah = 5 (ganjil), mustahil.

en: The sum of degrees must always be an EVEN number.
ms: Jumlah darjah bagi graf mesti sentiasa nombor GENAP.

en: 2 + 3 + 3 + 4 = 12 (even), satisfying ∑ d(v) = 2E.
ms: 2 + 3 + 3 + 4 = 12 (genap), mematuhi ∑ d(v) = 2E.

question.en: In a weighted delivery network, the distance of edges are: AB = 4 km, BC = 7 km, CD = 5 km, AD = 12 km. What is the distance of path A → B → C → D?
question.ms: Dalam rangkaian penghantaran berpemberat, jarak tepi ialah: AB = 4 km, BC = 7 km, CD = 5 km, AD = 12 km. Apakah jarak laluan A → B → C → D?

feedback.en: Correct! 4 + 7 + 5 = 16 km.
feedback.ms: Tepat! 4 + 7 + 5 = 16 km.

feedback.en: 12 km is the direct distance AD.
feedback.ms: 12 km ialah jarak terus AD.

feedback.en: Do not add all edges in the graph.
feedback.ms: Jangan tambah semua tepi dalam graf.

en: Add the weights along the path A → B → C → D: 4 + 7 + 5.
ms: Tambah pemberat sepanjang laluan A → B → C → D: 4 + 7 + 5.

en: Distance = 4 + 7 + 5 = 16 km.
ms: Jarak = 4 + 7 + 5 = 16 km.

question.en: Graph G has vertices V = {P, Q, R} and edges E = {PQ, QR}. Which of the following is a VALID subgraph of G?
question.ms: Graf G mempunyai bucu V = {P, Q, R} dan tepi E = {PQ, QR}. Antara berikut, yang manakah merupakan SUBGRAF yang sah bagi G?

feedback.en: Correct! V' ⊆ V and E' ⊆ E.
feedback.ms: Tepat! V' ⊆ V dan E' ⊆ E.

feedback.en: Edge PR does not exist in G, so this cannot be a subgraph.
feedback.ms: Tepi PR tidak wujud dalam G, maka bukan subgraf.

feedback.en: Vertex S is not in G.
feedback.ms: Bucu S tiada dalam G.

feedback.en: Edge QR requires both vertices Q and R to be in V'.
feedback.ms: Tepi QR memerlukan kedua-dua bucu Q dan R berada dalam V'.

en: A subgraph must only contain vertices and edges present in the original graph.
ms: Subgraf hanya boleh mengandungi bucu dan tepi yang wujud dalam graf asal.

en: V' = {P, Q} ⊆ V and E' = {PQ} ⊆ E.
ms: V' = {P, Q} ⊆ V dan E' = {PQ} ⊆ E.

question.en: A connected network connects 7 food outlets without any closed loops or cycles. How many edges (E) does this tree have?
question.ms: Rangkaian terhubung menghubungkan 7 cawangan makanan tanpa sebarang kitaran atau gelung. Berapakah bilangan tepi (E) bagi pokok ini?

feedback.en: Correct! A tree with n vertices always has E = n - 1 = 7 - 1 = 6 edges.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Pokok dengan n bucu sentiasa mempunyai E = n - 1 = 7 - 1 = 6 tepi.

feedback.en: 7 edges with 7 vertices would create a cycle.
feedback.ms: 7 tepi dengan 7 bucu akan membentuk kitaran.

feedback.en: 5 edges cannot connect 7 vertices.
feedback.ms: 5 tepi tidak mencukupi untuk menghubungkan 7 bucu.

feedback.en: A tree with 7 vertices has exactly 6 edges.
feedback.ms: Pokok dengan 7 bucu mempunyai tepat 6 tepi.

en: A tree with n vertices has exactly n - 1 edges.
ms: Suatu pokok dengan n bucu mempunyai tepat n - 1 tepi.

en: E = 7 - 1 = 6 edges.
ms: E = 7 - 1 = 6 tepi.

question.en: In a directed food hub graph, 4 delivery routes enter Hub H (in-degree) and 3 routes depart from Hub H (out-degree). What is the total degree of Hub H?
question.ms: Dalam graf terarah hab makanan, 4 laluan masuk ke Hab H (darjah masuk) dan 3 laluan keluar dari Hab H (darjah keluar). Apakah jumlah darjah bagi Hab H?

feedback.en: Correct! Total degree = in-degree + out-degree = 4 + 3 = 7.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jumlah darjah = darjah masuk + darjah keluar = 4 + 3 = 7.

feedback.en: 4 - 3 = 1 is the difference, not the total degree.
feedback.ms: 4 - 3 = 1 ialah beza, bukan jumlah darjah.

feedback.en: Do not multiply in-degree and out-degree.
feedback.ms: Jangan darab darjah masuk dan keluar.

feedback.en: 4 is only the in-degree.
feedback.ms: 4 hanya darjah masuk.

en: Total degree in a directed graph is d_in(v) + d_out(v).
ms: Jumlah darjah dalam graf terarah ialah d_masuk(v) + d_keluar(v).

question.en: A vendor connects 5 stalls into a network. The edge weights are: AB=3, BC=4, CD=2, DE=5, AE=6, BD=7, CE=3. What is the minimum weight of a spanning tree connecting all 5 stalls?
question.ms: Peniaga menghubungkan 5 gerai. Pemberat tepi: AB=3, BC=4, CD=2, DE=5, AE=6, BD=7, CE=3. Apakah jumlah pemberat minimum bagi pokok rentangan yang menghubungkan kelima-lima gerai?

feedback.en: Correct! Pick smallest non-cyclic edges: CD(2), AB(3), CE(3), BC(4) → Total = 2 + 3 + 3 + 4 = 12.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Pilih tepi terkecil tanpa kitaran: CD(2), AB(3), CE(3), BC(4) → Jumlah = 12.

feedback.en: You can achieve a lower weight of 12.
feedback.ms: Pemberat lebih rendah 12 boleh dicapai.

feedback.en: Check connectivity of all 5 vertices.
feedback.ms: Semak keterhubungan semua 5 bucu.

feedback.en: 17 is too large.
feedback.ms: 17 terlalu besar.

en: Use Kruskal's algorithm: select lowest weight edges without creating cycles until 4 edges are chosen.
ms: Gunakan algoritma Kruskal: pilih tepi berpemberat terendah tanpa kitaran sehingga 4 tepi dipilih.

en: Selected edges: CD(2), AB(3), CE(3), BC(4). Sum = 12.
ms: Tepi terpilih: CD(2), AB(3), CE(3), BC(4). Jumlah = 12.

question.en: Find the shortest distance from Central Kitchen S to Stall T via intermediate nodes A, B: SA=5, SB=8, AT=9, BT=4, AB=2.
question.ms: Cari jarak terpendek dari Dapur Pusat S ke Gerai T melalui nod perantaraan A, B: SA=5, SB=8, AT=9, BT=4, AB=2.

feedback.en: Correct! SA(5) + AB(2) + BT(4) = 11 km.
feedback.ms: Tepat! SA(5) + AB(2) + BT(4) = 11 km.

feedback.en: SB(8) + BT(4) = 12 km, but S → A → B → T is 11 km.
feedback.ms: SB(8) + BT(4) = 12 km, tetapi S → A → B → T ialah 11 km.

feedback.en: Shortest path is 11 km.
feedback.ms: Laluan terpendek ialah 11 km.

en: Compare all possible paths from S to T: S-A-T (14), S-B-T (12), S-A-B-T (11).
ms: Bandingkan semua laluan dari S ke T: S-A-T (14), S-B-T (12), S-A-B-T (11).

question.en: A rider wants to traverse every road in a delivery network exactly once and return to the starting point (Eulerian circuit). What condition must the graph satisfy?
question.ms: Penunggang ingin melalui setiap jalan dalam rangkaian tepat sekali dan kembali ke titik permulaan (litar Euler). Apakah syarat yang mesti dipenuhi?

options.text: All vertices must have even degrees.

feedback.en: Correct! An Eulerian circuit exists if and only if every vertex has an even degree.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Litar Euler wujud jika dan hanya jika setiap bucu mempunyai darjah genap.

options.text: Exactly two vertices have odd degrees.

feedback.en: That allows an Eulerian path, not a circuit returning to start.
feedback.ms: Itu bagi laluan Euler, bukan litar yang kembali ke permulaan.

options.text: The graph must be a tree.

feedback.en: A tree has vertices of degree 1, which cannot form an Eulerian circuit.
feedback.ms: Pokok mempunyai bucu berdarjah 1, tidak boleh membentuk litar Euler.

feedback.en: Degrees can be 4, 6, etc., as long as all are even.
feedback.ms: Darjah boleh 4, 6, dsb., asalkan semuanya genap.

en: To enter and leave every vertex every time, each vertex must have an even number of edges.
ms: Untuk masuk dan keluar bucu setiap kali, setiap bucu mesti mempunyai bilangan tepi yang genap.

en: An Eulerian circuit requires all vertices to be connected and have even degrees.
ms: Litar Euler memerlukan semua bucu terhubung dan berdarjah genap.

question.en: In a supply network from depot to stall: route 1 capacity is 50 kg/h, route 2 capacity is 40 kg/h. If both converge into a single bridge of capacity 70 kg/h, what is the maximum delivery flow rate?
question.ms: Dalam rangkaian bekalan dari depot ke gerai: kapasiti laluan 1 ialah 50 kg/j, kapasiti laluan 2 ialah 40 kg/j. Jika kedua-duanya bergabung ke sebuah jambatan berkapasiti 70 kg/j, apakah kadar aliran maksimum?

feedback.en: Correct! Total potential inflow is 50 + 40 = 90, but the bottleneck bridge restricts it to 70 kg/h.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Aliran masuk berpotensi ialah 90, tetapi jambatan menghadkan kepada 70 kg/j.

feedback.en: 90 exceeds the bridge bottleneck capacity of 70 kg/h.
feedback.ms: 90 melebihi kapasiti had jambatan 70 kg/j.

feedback.en: Both routes can be utilized up to 70 kg/h total.
feedback.ms: Kedua-dua laluan boleh digunakan sehingga jumlah 70 kg/j.

feedback.en: Underestimated flow.
feedback.ms: Aliran terkurang anggaran.

en: Maximum flow is constrained by the minimum cut / bottleneck capacity.
ms: Aliran maksimum dihadkan oleh kapasiti kekangan / potongan minimum.

en: Max flow = Min(50 + 40, 70) = 70 kg/h.
ms: Aliran maks = Min(50 + 40, 70) = 70 kg/j.

question.en: Two separate food stalls networks are trees: Tree 1 has 5 vertices, Tree 2 has 4 vertices. How many edges must be added to connect them into a single unified tree?
question.ms: Dua rangkaian gerai berasingan adalah pokok: Pokok 1 mempunyai 5 bucu, Pokok 2 mempunyai 4 bucu. Berapakah bilangan tepi yang perlu ditambah untuk mencantumkannya menjadi satu pokok tunggal?

equation: Single Tree with 9 vertices needs 8 edges

feedback.en: Correct! Total vertices = 9. Unified tree requires 8 edges. Currently have (5-1) + (4-1) = 7 edges. Adding 1 edge makes 8 edges.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jumlah bucu = 9. Pokok tunggal perlukan 8 tepi. Sedia ada 4 + 3 = 7 tepi. Tambah 1 tepi menjadikan 8 tepi.

feedback.en: Adding 2 edges would create a cycle between the two components.
feedback.ms: Menambah 2 tepi akan membentuk kitaran antara kedua-dua komponen.

feedback.en: Only 1 edge is needed to join two disjoint trees into one.
feedback.ms: Hanya 1 tepi diperlukan untuk mencantumkan dua pokok berasingan.

feedback.en: They are currently disconnected.
feedback.ms: Kedua-duanya kini tidak terhubung.

en: Total vertices = 5 + 4 = 9. A tree with 9 vertices has 8 edges. Existing edges = 4 + 3 = 7.
ms: Jumlah bucu = 5 + 4 = 9. Pokok dengan 9 bucu mempunyai 8 tepi. Tepi sedia ada = 4 + 3 = 7.

en: 8 - 7 = 1 edge needed.
ms: 8 - 7 = 1 tepi diperlukan.

question.en: A graph has 7 edges. What is the sum of degrees of all vertices in the graph, Σ d(v)?
question.ms: Suatu graf mempunyai 7 tepi. Apakah hasil tambah darjah bagi semua bucu dalam graf tersebut, Σ d(v)?

feedback.en: Correct! Σ d(v) = 2 * E = 2 * 7 = 14.
Remember to multiply the number of edges by 2.
feedback.ms: Ingat darabkan bilangan tepi dengan 2.

feedback.en: Formula is 2 * E, not 3 * E.
feedback.ms: Rumus ialah 2 * E, bukan 3 * E.

feedback.en: Do not square the edges.
feedback.ms: Jangan kuasakan dua bilangan tepi.

en: Use the Handshaking Lemma: Σ d(v) = 2E.
ms: Gunakan rumus: Σ d(v) = 2E.

en: The sum of degrees is always twice the number of edges: 2 × 7 = 14.
ms: Hasil tambah darjah sentiasa dua kali ganda bilangan tepi: 2 × 7 = 14.

question.en: A tree has 9 vertices. How many edges does this tree have?
question.ms: Sebuah pokok mempunyai 9 bucu. Berapakah bilangan tepi yang dimiliki oleh pokok ini?

feedback.en: Correct! For any tree, E = V - 1 = 9 - 1 = 8.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Bagi sebarang pokok, E = V - 1 = 9 - 1 = 8.

feedback.en: If E = V, the graph contains a cycle and is not a tree.
feedback.ms: Jika E = V, graf mempunyai kitaran dan bukan pokok.

feedback.en: A tree with V vertices has V - 1 edges.
feedback.ms: Pokok dengan V bucu mempunyai V - 1 tepi.

en: For a tree: Number of edges = Number of vertices - 1.
ms: Bagi sebuah pokok: Bilangan tepi = Bilangan bucu - 1.

en: A tree is an acyclic connected graph where E = V - 1. E = 9 - 1 = 8.
ms: Pokok ialah graf bersambung tanpa kitaran di mana E = V - 1. E = 9 - 1 = 8.

question.en: Which of the following is true for a simple graph?
question.ms: Antara berikut, yang manakah benar bagi suatu graf mudah?

text.en: It has no loops and no multiple edges
text.ms: Ia tidak mempunyai gelung dan tiada berbilang tepi

feedback.en: Correct! A simple graph has no loops and no parallel (multiple) edges.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Graf mudah tidak mengandungi sebarang gelung atau tepi berbilang.

text.en: It must have at least one loop
text.ms: Ia mesti mempunyai sekurang-kurangnya satu gelung

feedback.en: A simple graph cannot have loops.
feedback.ms: Graf mudah tidak boleh ada gelung.

text.en: It must have directed arrows on edges
text.ms: Ia mesti mempunyai anak panah berarah pada tepi

feedback.en: That describes a directed graph.
feedback.ms: Itu graf berarah.

text.en: It is disconnected into two parts

feedback.en: Incorrect.
feedback.ms: Salah.

en: Simple graph = no loops + no multiple edges.
ms: Graf mudah = tiada gelung + tiada berbilang tepi.

en: By definition, a simple graph contains no loops and no multiple edges.
ms: Mengikut definisi, graf mudah tidak mengandungi gelung mahupun berbilang tepi.

question.en: How many degrees does a single loop contribute to a vertex?
question.ms: Berapakah bilangan darjah yang disumbangkan oleh satu gelung kepada suatu bucu?

feedback.en: Correct! A loop starts and ends at the same vertex, contributing 2 to its degree.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Gelung bermula dan berakhir pada bucu yang sama, menyumbang 2 darjah.

feedback.en: A loop connects to the vertex twice.
feedback.ms: Gelung menyambung bucu dua kali.

feedback.en: A loop adds degree to the vertex.
feedback.ms: Gelung menambah darjah bucu.

feedback.en: A single loop contributes 2.
feedback.ms: Satu gelung menyumbang 2.

en: Both ends of the loop attach to the same vertex.
ms: Kedua-dua hujung gelung melekat pada bucu yang sama.

en: Each loop adds 2 to the degree of the incident vertex.
ms: Setiap gelung menyumbang 2 kepada darjah bucu berkenaan.

question.en: In a food delivery graph, what do weights on the edges typically represent?
question.ms: Dalam graf penghantaran makanan, apakah yang lazimnya diwakili oleh pemberat pada tepi graf?

text.en: Distance, travel time, or delivery cost between locations
text.ms: Jarak, masa perjalanan, atau kos penghantaran antara lokasi

feedback.en: Correct! Weights represent numeric values like distance or time.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Pemberat mewakili nilai kuantitatif seperti jarak atau masa.

text.en: The name of the delivery rider

feedback.en: Weights are numerical values.
feedback.ms: Pemberat ialah nilai angka.

text.en: The number of customers at a table

feedback.en: Vertices represent locations, edges represent routes with weights.
feedback.ms: Bucu mewakili lokasi, tepi mewakili laluan dengan pemberat.

feedback.en: Irrelevant.
feedback.ms: Tidak relevan.

en: A weighted graph assigns values (distance, time, cost) to edges.
ms: Graf berpemberat memberikan nilai (jarak, masa, kos) kepada tepi.

en: In practical applications like food delivery networks, edge weights denote physical distance, time, or cost.
ms: Dalam aplikasi seperti rangkaian penghantaran makanan, pemberat pada tepi mewakili jarak, masa, atau kos.

question.en: The degrees of vertices of a graph are 3, 2, 4, 3, 2, and 2. Calculate the total number of edges in this graph.
question.ms: Darjah bagi bucu-bucu suatu graf ialah 3, 2, 4, 3, 2, dan 2. Hitung jumlah bilangan tepi dalam graf ini.

feedback.en: 16 is the sum of degrees, divide by 2 to get edges.
feedback.ms: 16 ialah hasil tambah darjah, bahagikan dengan 2 untuk dapat bilangan tepi.

feedback.en: 6 is the number of vertices.
feedback.ms: 6 ialah bilangan bucu.

feedback.en: Check your addition and division.
feedback.ms: Semak penambahan dan pembahagian anda.

en: Sum all degrees, then divide by 2.
ms: Jumlahkan semua darjah, kemudian bahagikan dengan 2.

question.en: Which set of properties proves a connected graph with 6 vertices is a tree?
question.ms: Ciri-ciri manakah yang membuktikan suatu graf bersambung dengan 6 bucu ialah sebuah pokok?

text.en: It has 5 edges and no cycles
text.ms: Ia mempunyai 5 tepi dan tiada kitaran

feedback.en: Correct! E = V - 1 = 6 - 1 = 5, and it contains no cycles.
feedback.ms: Tepat! E = V - 1 = 6 - 1 = 5, dan ia tidak mengandungi sebarang kitaran.

feedback.en: A tree cannot contain any cycles.
feedback.ms: Pokok tidak boleh mengandungi sebarang kitaran.

text.en: It has 7 edges and multiple edges
text.ms: Ia mempunyai 7 tepi dan berbilang tepi

feedback.en: Too many edges for a tree.
feedback.ms: Terlalu banyak tepi untuk pokok.

text.en: It has loops on two vertices
text.ms: Ia mempunyai gelung pada dua bucu

feedback.en: A tree has no loops.
feedback.ms: Pokok tiada gelung.

en: A tree with V vertices has V - 1 edges and no cycles.
ms: Pokok dengan V bucu mempunyai V - 1 tepi dan tiada kitaran.

en: For V = 6, a tree must have exactly E = 5 edges and contain no closed cycles.
ms: Bagi V = 6, sebuah pokok mesti mempunyai tepat E = 5 tepi dan tidak mengandungi kitaran tertutup.

question.en: In a directed kitchen workflow graph, vertex 'Stove' has 3 incoming arrows (in-degree) and 2 outgoing arrows (out-degree). What is the total degree d(Stove)?
question.ms: Dalam satu graf berarah aliran kerja dapur, bucu 'Dapur Gas' mempunyai 3 anak panah masuk (darjah masuk) dan 2 anak panah keluar (darjah keluar). Apakah jumlah darjah d(Dapur Gas)?

feedback.en: Correct! Total degree = in-degree + out-degree = 3 + 2 = 5.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jumlah darjah = darjah masuk + darjah keluar = 3 + 2 = 5.

feedback.en: Do not subtract in-degree and out-degree.
feedback.ms: Jangan tolak darjah masuk dan keluar.

feedback.en: Do not multiply.
feedback.ms: Jangan darab.

feedback.en: 3 is only the in-degree.
feedback.ms: 3 hanya darjah masuk.

en: Total degree of a vertex in a directed graph is d_in + d_out.
ms: Jumlah darjah bucu dalam graf berarah ialah d_masuk + d_keluar.
d(v) = d_masuk(v) + d_keluar(v) = 3 + 2 = 5.

question.en: Which statement correctly defines a subgraph H of graph G?
question.ms: Pernyataan manakah yang mentakrifkan subgraf H bagi graf G dengan betul?

text.en: V(H) ⊆ V(G) and E(H) ⊆ E(G), with edges connecting corresponding vertices in H
text.ms: V(H) ⊆ V(G) dan E(H) ⊆ E(G), dengan tepi menyambungkan bucu yang sepadan dalam H

feedback.en: Correct! Vertices and edges of H are subsets of vertices and edges of G.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Bucu dan tepi H ialah subset bagi bucu dan tepi G.

text.en: H has more vertices than G
text.ms: H mempunyai lebih banyak bucu daripada G

feedback.en: A subgraph cannot have vertices outside G.
feedback.ms: Subgraf tidak boleh ada bucu di luar G.

text.en: H must always be a complete graph

feedback.en: Subgraphs do not have to be complete.
feedback.ms: Subgraf tidak semestinya lengkap.

text.en: H has edges that connect to vertices outside G
text.ms: H mempunyai tepi yang menyambung bucu di luar G

feedback.en: Edges of H must connect vertices within H.
feedback.ms: Tepi H mesti menyambung bucu dalam H.

en: A subgraph is a part of the original graph G: V(H) ⊆ V(G) and E(H) ⊆ E(G).
ms: Subgraf ialah sebahagian daripada graf asal G: V(H) ⊆ V(G) dan E(H) ⊆ E(G).

en: A subgraph H consists of a subset of vertices V(H) ⊆ V(G) and a subset of edges E(H) ⊆ E(G).
ms: Subgraf H terdiri daripada subset bucu V(H) ⊆ V(G) dan subset tepi E(H) ⊆ E(G).

question.en:
A delivery route has routes from Warung (W) to Customer (C):
Route 1: W -> A -> C with weights 4 km + 5 km = 9 km
Route 2: W -> B -> C with weights 3 km + 4 km = 7 km
Route 3: W -> A -> B -> C with weights 4 km + 2 km + 4 km = 10 km
What is the shortest delivery distance?
question.ms:
Laluan penghantaran dari Warung (W) ke Pelanggan (C):
Laluan 1: W -> A -> C dengan pemberat 4 km + 5 km = 9 km
Laluan 2: W -> B -> C dengan pemberat 3 km + 4 km = 7 km
Laluan 3: W -> A -> B -> C dengan pemberat 4 km + 2 km + 4 km = 10 km
Apakah jarak penghantaran terpendek?

feedback.en: Correct! Route W -> B -> C is the shortest with 7 km.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Laluan W -> B -> C adalah terpendek dengan 7 km.

feedback.en: 9 km is longer than 7 km.
feedback.ms: 9 km lebih jauh daripada 7 km.

feedback.en: 10 km is the longest route.
feedback.ms: 10 km ialah laluan terpanjang.

feedback.en: No route has distance 6 km.
feedback.ms: Tiada laluan berjarak 6 km.

en: Compare the sums of edge weights for each possible path.
ms: Bandingkan jumlah pemberat tepi bagi setiap laluan yang mungkin.

en: Comparing paths: W-A-C (9 km), W-B-C (7 km), W-A-B-C (10 km). Minimum is 7 km.
ms: Membandingkan laluan: W-A-C (9 km), W-B-C (7 km), W-A-B-C (10 km). Jarak minimum ialah 7 km.

question.en: Which of the following degree sequences CANNOT represent a simple graph?
question.ms: Antara urutan darjah berikut, yang manakah TIDAK BOLEH mewakili suatu graf mudah?

equation: Σ d(v) must be even, d(v) ≤ V - 1

feedback.en: Correct! Sum of degrees is 3 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 9 (odd number). The sum of degrees must always be even!
feedback.ms: Tepat! Hasil tambah darjah ialah 3 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 9 (nombor ganjil). Hasil tambah darjah mestilah sentiasa genap!

feedback.en: Sum is 8 (even), valid (a 4-cycle).
feedback.ms: Jumlah ialah 8 (genap), sah (kitaran 4 sisi).

feedback.en: Sum is 8 (even), valid simple tree/graph.
feedback.ms: Jumlah ialah 8 (genap), sah.

feedback.en: Sum is 4 (even), two disjoint edges.
feedback.ms: Jumlah ialah 4 (genap), dua tepi berasingan.

en: Remember: Σ d(v) = 2E, so the sum of degrees MUST be an even number.
ms: Ingat: Σ d(v) = 2E, jadi hasil tambah darjah MESTILAH nombor genap.

en: 3 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 9, which is odd. Since Σ d(v) = 2E must be even, this graph cannot exist.
ms: 3 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 9 (ganjil). Kerana Σ d(v) = 2E mestilah nombor genap, graf ini mustahil wujud.

question.en:
Mama wants to connect 5 cooking stations (A, B, C, D, E) with gas pipes at minimum cost. The pipe costs between stations are:
AB=4, BC=3, CD=2, DE=5, AE=8, AC=6, BD=7, CE=4.
What is the minimum cost to form a connected gas pipe network (spanning tree)?
question.ms:
Mama ingin menyambungkan 5 stesen memasak (A, B, C, D, E) dengan paip gas pada kos minimum. Kos paip antara stesen ialah:
AB=4, BC=3, CD=2, DE=5, AE=8, AC=6, BD=7, CE=4.
Apakah kos minimum untuk membentuk rangkaian paip bersambung (pokok rentang)?

feedback.en: Correct! Pick cheapest edges without cycles: CD(2) + BC(3) + AB(4) + CE(4) = 13.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Pilih tepi termurah tanpa kitaran: CD(2) + BC(3) + AB(4) + CE(4) = 13.

feedback.en: Using DE(5) instead of CE(4) gives 14, but CE(4) is cheaper.
feedback.ms: Guna DE(5) menghasilkan 14, tetapi CE(4) lebih murah.

feedback.en: Recalculate using Kruskal's algorithm.
feedback.ms: Kira semula menggunakan algoritma Kruskal.

feedback.en: Too expensive.
feedback.ms: Terlalu mahal.

en: Connect 5 vertices with 4 edges: CD(2), BC(3), AB(4), CE(4).
ms: Sambung 5 bucu dengan 4 tepi: CD(2), BC(3), AB(4), CE(4).

en: Sorted edges: CD(2), BC(3), AB(4), CE(4). These 4 edges connect all 5 stations without forming cycles. Total cost = 2 + 3 + 4 + 4 = RM 13.
ms: Tepi mengikut tertib: CD(2), BC(3), AB(4), CE(4). 4 tepi ini menyambung semua 5 stesen tanpa kitaran. Jumlah kos = 2 + 3 + 4 + 4 = RM 13.

question.en: A graph has 4 vertices. It contains 1 loop, 2 pairs of multiple edges (parallel edges), and 3 simple edges. What is the sum of degrees of all vertices, Σ d(v)?
question.ms: Suatu graf mempunyai 4 bucu. Ia mengandungi 1 gelung, 2 pasang tepi berbilang (tepi selari), dan 3 tepi mudah. Apakah hasil tambah darjah semua bucu, Σ d(v)?

feedback.en: Correct! 1 loop = 1 edge. 2 pairs of multiple edges = 4 edges. 3 simple edges = 3 edges. Total E = 8. Σ d(v) = 2 * 8 = 16.
feedback.ms: Tepat! 1 gelung = 1 tepi. 2 pasang tepi berbilang = 4 tepi. 3 tepi mudah = 3 tepi. Jumlah E = 8. Σ d(v) = 2 * 8 = 16.

feedback.en: Remember each pair of multiple edges has 2 edges (total 4).
feedback.ms: Ingat setiap pasang tepi berbilang ada 2 tepi (jumlah 4).

feedback.en: Don't forget the loop counts as an edge contributing 2 degrees.
feedback.ms: Jangan lupa gelung dikira sebagai satu tepi yang menyumbang 2 darjah.

feedback.en: 8 is the total number of edges, Σ d(v) is 2 * E.
feedback.ms: 8 ialah bilangan tepi, Σ d(v) ialah 2 * E.

en: Find total edges E: 1 loop (1 edge) + 2 pairs (4 edges) + 3 simple (3 edges) = 8 edges. Then Σ d(v) = 2E.
ms: Cari jumlah tepi E: 1 gelung (1 tepi) + 2 pasang (4 tepi) + 3 mudah (3 tepi) = 8 tepi. Maka Σ d(v) = 2E.

en: Total edges E = 1 + (2 × 2) + 3 = 8 edges. Sum of degrees = 2 × 8 = 16.
ms: Jumlah tepi E = 1 + (2 × 2) + 3 = 8 tepi. Hasil tambah darjah = 2 × 8 = 16.

question.en: What is the maximum number of edges that a simple graph with n vertices can have?
question.ms: Apakah bilangan tepi maksimum yang boleh dimiliki oleh suatu graf mudah dengan n bucu?

feedback.en: Correct! Each of the n vertices can connect to (n - 1) other vertices without loops/multiple edges.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Setiap daripada n bucu boleh bersambung ke (n - 1) bucu lain tanpa gelung/tepi berbilang.

feedback.en: This is for a directed complete graph.
feedback.ms: Ini untuk graf lengkap berarah.

feedback.en: n - 1 is the number of edges in a tree.
feedback.ms: n - 1 ialah bilangan tepi dalam pokok.

feedback.en: Incorrect formula.
feedback.ms: Rumus salah.

en: Formula for combinations of 2 from n: nC2 = n(n - 1) / 2.
ms: Rumus gabungan 2 daripada n: nC2 = n(n - 1) / 2.

en: In a complete simple graph, each pair of vertices has exactly 1 edge: E_max = n(n - 1) / 2.
ms: Dalam graf mudah lengkap, setiap pasangan bucu ada tepat 1 tepi: E_max = n(n - 1) / 2.

question.en: Delivery rider starts at Warung (O), visits customers A and B, and returns to O. Route distances: OA = 5 km, OB = 4 km, AB = 3 km. What is the total distance of this round trip?
question.ms: Penghantar makanan bertolak dari Warung (O), menghantar ke pelanggan A dan B, kemudian kembali ke O. Jarak laluan: OA = 5 km, OB = 4 km, AB = 3 km. Apakah jumlah jarak perjalanan pergi balik ini?

feedback.en: Correct! Round trip distance: OA + AB + BO = 5 + 3 + 4 = 12 km.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jarak pergi balik: OA + AB + BO = 5 + 3 + 4 = 12 km.

feedback.en: Check your sum.
feedback.ms: Semak hasil tambah anda.

feedback.en: Don't forget the return leg to Warung (BO).
feedback.ms: Jangan lupa laluan pulang ke Warung (BO).

en: Sum the perimeter of the triangle formed: OA + AB + BO.
ms: Jumlahkan perimeter segi tiga yang terbentuk: OA + AB + BO.

en: Circuit distance = OA + AB + BO = 5 + 3 + 4 = 12 km.
ms: Jarak litar perjalanan = OA + AB + BO = 5 + 3 + 4 = 12 km.
